Diff values between two domain snapshots

diff_values.Rd

Compares one or more variables on matched keys between two DomainSnapshot objects.

Usage

diff_values(old_dom, new_dom, vars = "AVAL")

Arguments

old_dom

Previous DomainSnapshot.

new_dom

Current DomainSnapshot.

vars

Character vector of variables to compare.

Value

A data.frame with key columns, var, old, and new for changed values.

Examples

old_dom <- new_domain_snapshot(
  name = "ADVS",
  data = example_advs(),
  key_vars = c("USUBJID", "PARAMCD", "AVISIT")
)
new_data <- example_advs()
new_data$AVAL[new_data$USUBJID == "STUDY01-002" & new_data$AVISIT == "WEEK 4"] <- 141
new_dom <- new_domain_snapshot(
  name = "ADVS",
  data = new_data,
  key_vars = c("USUBJID", "PARAMCD", "AVISIT")
)
diff_values(old_dom, new_dom, vars = c("AVAL", "CHG"))
#>       USUBJID PARAMCD AVISIT  var old new
#> 4 STUDY01-002   SYSBP WEEK 4 AVAL 136 141
